SkillPointsLevel5.Name: Skill Points for Level 5 Skills
SkillPointsLevel5.Hint: Skill points required to reach level 1 of a 5-level skill. The requirement doubles for each subsequent level.

SkillPointsLevel10.Name: Skill Points for Level 10 Skills
SkillPointsLevel10.Hint: Skill points required to reach level 1 of a 10-level skill. The requirement increases by this amount for each subsequent level.

CarryWeightFormula.Name: Max Carry Weight Formula
CarryWeightFormula.Hint: Base max carry weight, before size-category scaling (Tiny 25%, Small 75%, Medium 100%, Large 150%, Huge 300%, Gigantic 1000%, Titanic unlimited). A real roll formula - reference attributes as @attributes.str.value or @attributes.str.mod, skill levels as @skills.<key> (e.g. @skills.axe), and character level as @lvl.

Materials.Hint: Materials selectable on Items/Armor/Weapons. Material Bonus and Mana Capacity may each be a number, or "?" to let each item using this material set its own value instead.
Materials.Label: Configure Materials

Models.Name: Models
Models.Hint: Weapon Models (by weapon type) and Armor Models (Light Armor, Heavy Armor, Shield) selectable on Weapons/Armor.
Models.Label: Configure Models

General.NoFavoriteSkills: No favorite skills yet - star one in the Skills tab.

Materials.VariableHint: A non-negative number, or "?" to let each item using this material set its own value

Life.MaxComputed: Automatically calculated from Classes, Constitution, Health, Tenacity and abilities - not directly editable

NegativeLife.MaxComputed: Automatically calculated from max life, minus Tenacity's multiplier unless enabled on the GM tab - not directly editable
NegativeLife.IncludeToughness: Tenacity also raises max negative life
NegativeLife.IncludeToughnessHint: Let Tenacity's multiplier also raise max negative life, instead of only max life

Mana.MaxComputed: Automatically calculated from Aura, Mana Capacity, Source Bound, Mana Core and abilities - not directly editable

ActionPoints.MaxComputed: Automatically calculated from a base of 3 plus Reflexes (up to level 3) and any effects - not directly editable

ReactionPoints.MaxComputed: Automatically calculated from max AP and Reflexes beyond level 3 - not directly editable

Ability.LifeBonusFormulaHint: Added to max life once this ability is unlocked. Supports "L" for the actor's level, e.g. "L * 2".
Ability.ManaBonusFormulaHint: Added to max mana once this ability is unlocked. Supports "L" for the actor's level, e.g. "L * 2".

Heavy.Name: Heavy
Heavy.Hint: This item is heavy and requires a Strength score of at least the given requirement to use effectively. A weapon with this modifier can't be wielded in both hands until the character's Strength is well above that requirement.

Demanding.Name: Demanding
Demanding.Hint: This item is hard to handle and requires a Dexterity score of at least the given requirement to use effectively. A weapon with this modifier can't be wielded in both hands until the character's Dexterity is well above that requirement.

Draining.Name: Draining
Draining.Hint: Using this item quickly tires its bearer and requires a Constitution score of at least the given requirement to use effectively. A weapon with this modifier can't be wielded in both hands until the character's Constitution is well above that requirement.

Refined.Name: Refined
Refined.Hint: This weapon uses one of its listed attributes (user's choice). Incompatible with Specialized and Masterful.

Specialized.Name: Specialized
Specialized.Hint: This weapon uses its listed attribute twice. Incompatible with Simple, Refined and Masterful. If combined with the Two-Handed modifier, this modifier loses its effect unless the weapon is wielded two-handed.

Masterful.Name: Masterful
Masterful.Hint: This item is far better in the hands of someone who has mastered two attributes. Such an item uses two attributes - the higher of the two is used, and if both are equal, both are used. Incompatible with Simple, Refined and Specialized.

Rending.Name: Rending
Rending.Hint: A weapon with this modifier deals double damage to buildings, constructs, corporeal undead, objects, and inorganic obstacles.

Stunning.Name: Stunning
Stunning.Hint: A critical hit with a weapon with this modifier grants the target several stacks of Dazed. The amount equals Material Bonus / 2, multiplied by 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 if this weapon has the Heavy (Reduced) / Heavy / Heavy (Increased) modifier.

Disarming.Name: Disarming
Disarming.Hint: A creature using an item with this modifier can, as a reaction to a weapon attack, attempt to disarm the attacker. The attacker must succeed a DC 16 Dexterity or DC 18 Strength save (attacker's choice) or be disarmed on failure. The target's attack also fails on a failed save.

Ranged.Name: Ranged
Ranged.Hint: A weapon with this modifier can be used to attack at range (given in parentheses / disadvantage at extended range). In melee, i.e. 2m or less from the target, such a weapon can't be used to attack.

Flexible.Name: Flexible
Flexible.Hint: A weapon with this modifier can be used either one-handed or two-handed.

Shapeshifting.Name: Shapeshifting
Shapeshifting.Hint: This item can change its shape. It can turn a weapon into another one, or even into a piece of armor. This modifier can't change the item's overall mass. Costs 3 Action Points.

Infusion.Name: Infusion
Infusion.Hint: This weapon can be charged with mana, enabling the Magical Attacks and Deadly Attacks abilities. If this effect is natural to a material, it's lost if the weapon is enchanted (unless with this modifier). Antimagic items with this modifier can be enchanted or magically enhanced.

Unstable.Name: Unstable
Unstable.Hint: An item with this modifier is unstable. Each round, a D10 must be rolled - on a 10, the item spontaneously changes shape. This modifier can only be applied to items with the Shapeshifting modifier or the Shape-Adapting enchantment.

Long.Name: Long
Long.Hint: A weapon with this modifier has double the melee reach.

Light.Name: Light
Light.Hint: A weapon with this modifier grants its bearer an additional AP.

Antimagic.Name: Antimagic
Antimagic.Hint: An item with this modifier can't be enchanted, deals double damage to magical shields, and makes an illusion flicker on touch. The attacked creature also has disadvantage on its Concentration save. Armor made from materials with this modifier grants Magic Resistance equal to (AC granted / 2, rounded down).

Reach.Name: Reach
Reach.Hint: A weapon with this modifier can be used to attack at range (given in parentheses). Beyond 2m, the attack and damage roll use the given attribute modifier.

GiantSlayer.Name: Giant Slayer
GiantSlayer.Hint: Large-sized creatures take 25% extra damage, Gigantic-sized creatures take 50% extra damage, Titanic-sized creatures take 100% extra damage.

VeryLong.Name: Very Long
VeryLong.Hint: A weapon with this modifier has triple the melee reach.

Simple.Name: Simple
Simple.Hint: A weapon or armor with this modifier can be used effectively even without the corresponding skill. At the same time, it gains no bonus from skills (though skill points for the corresponding skill can still be earned). Incompatible with Specialized, Masterful and Refined.

Redirection.Name: Redirection
Redirection.Hint: The bearer of an item with this modifier can, as a reaction, redirect a non-area attack to the nearest creature within 2m, unless that creature succeeds a DC 15 Constitution save. Magical attacks can only be redirected with this modifier if it was granted via enchantment.

Silvered.Name: Silvered
Silvered.Hint: Weapons made from this material deal extra damage to certain creatures.

Concealed.Name: Concealed
Concealed.Hint: An attack with this weapon doesn't automatically break stealth. Creatures hit by an attack with such a weapon gain advantage on their next Observation check to reveal the attacker.

Wounding.Name: Wounding
Wounding.Hint: A successful attack with this weapon automatically inflicts a Wound.

Throwable.Name: Throwable
Throwable.Hint: This item can be thrown (no penalty on weapon attacks). A weapon enchanted with this modifier returns after the attack.

Shattering.Name: Shattering
Shattering.Hint: The AC of a creature hit by a weapon with this modifier is reduced for one round by the number of weapon dice. This effect can stack until the equipment's AC modifier reaches 0.

TwoHanded.Name: Two-Handed
TwoHanded.Hint: A weapon with this modifier must be wielded two-handed. Unless such a weapon also has the Heavy, Demanding or Draining modifier, it can be wielded one-handed if the bearer has a Strength score of 18 or higher.

Deployable.Name: Deployable
Deployable.Hint: A shield with this modifier can be deployed, after which it counts as an inorganic obstacle providing full or half cover.

ArmBound.Name: Arm-Bound
ArmBound.Hint: A shield with this modifier can't be lost unless the bearing arm is severed. Additionally, the hand of the arm wielding this shield can still be used for attacks.

Hardened.Name: Hardened (X)
Hardened.Hint: This item is hardened and grants AC increased by X (maximum is Material Bonus / 2).

Loud.Name: Loud
Loud.Hint: The bearer has disadvantage on Stealth checks while wearing this item.

Reflective.Name: Reflective
Reflective.Hint: Reflects 10% of the magical damage its bearer takes back onto the source.

Flawless.Name: Flawless
Flawless.Hint: A critical attack roll made against the bearer of an item with this modifier still hits automatically, but deals no extra damage.

Spiky.Name: Spiky
Spiky.Hint: Creatures that attack the bearer of such an item with a melee weapon attack take 1d6 piercing damage.
